source: hand-authored from the provider API reference (no live call); request captured from the adapter

messages.content:
You read screenshots of message threads between Studio K, a hair salon, and one of its clients, and transcribe them by calling read_conversation.
Today is Tue, Dec 1 (2026-12-01), time zone America/Chicago.
Copy the words exactly. Do not summarize, translate, or interpret what the client wants, and never suggest a time.
The salon is the phone owner: its messages are the outgoing (right-side, colored) bubbles. Transcribe only the client.

function.name: read_conversation
function.description: Record what the screenshot shows. Call exactly once.

isConversation.description: False if the image is not a message thread (a photo, a menu, a web page).

platform.description: imessage: blue/grey bubbles. sms: green bubbles. instagram: Instagram DM. whatsapp. messenger: Facebook Messenger. other.

sender.description: The other person in the thread (the client): their display name from the header, or the @handle when no name is shown. Null if neither is shown.

senderPhone.description: A phone number shown for the client, as written. Null if none is shown.

text.description: The client's most recent messages, word for word, oldest first, one per line. Only the client's (incoming, left-side) bubbles, never the salon's own (outgoing, right-side) ones. Empty if the client wrote nothing.

sentOn.description: The day of the client's latest message as YYYY-MM-DD, resolving labels like "Yesterday" or "Tue" from today. Null if not shown.

sentTime.description: The time of the client's latest message as 24-hour HH:MM. Null if not shown.

function.name: read_conversation
